verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio documents a first-party 'Phaser Game Agent' (phaser.io/agent) where users describe a game in plain language and the agent builds/edits it, plus an MCP server that lets external coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) call Phaser Editor tools — both vendor-first-party evidence of an AI assistant tied to the product. However this is a hosted/editor-side agent rather than an assistant embedded in the core Phaser game-engine library itself, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of its reliability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the AI agent's task delegation, clarity on whether it's bundled with the core npm package vs. a separate paid editor product, and evidence of robustness beyond marketing copy.
